 MIRESI: Invisible Future to Appear at Comiket 109
 Set for one of Tokyo's most notable conventions.
 By: Soul Kiwami 
 Published:
 November 9, 2026 
 Smilegate has announced that Control9’s MIRESI: Invisible Future will make its debut at Comic Market 109 (Comiket 109), which will be held at the Tokyo Big Sight from December 29 to 31. A dedicated MIRESI: Invisible Future booth will be present at Tokyo Big Sight’s West Hall 4 during Comiket 109, where fans can learn more about the game and connect with fans in Japan’s subculture gaming community. More details about the booth and event will be revealed on the game’s official X (formerly Twitter) account .
 MIRESI: Invisible Future is coming soon to Android, iOS, and PC via Stove. The game is a new collectible RPG by Control9, and it’s garnered a lot of attention thanks to the participation of art director Hyung-sup “Hyulla” Kim, who has a large fanbase in Korea and overseas. The game made its debut at last year’s Tokyo Game Show, and since then, it has also drawn attention at Korea’s Anime x Game Festival and Anime Expo 2026. Fans were also able to see how MIRESI: Invisible Future has evolved in its development at Tokyo Game Show 2026.
 Comic Market 109 will mark Comiket’s return to the three-day event format nearly 5 years after the COVID-19 pandemic, ensuring anime, manga, and gaming fans have an extra day to explore the event. Comiket 109 will be held at the Tokyo Big Sight venue, but East 4-6 Halls will be unavailable due to renovations.
